_meta.name: pano_upscale_esrgan
_meta.description: Deterministic 4x ESRGAN upscale for equirectangular panoramas (no diffusion). LoadImage -> RealESRGAN_x4plus -> SaveImage. Built for The Archive U1 (skybox to >=8K per Apple's 40ppd guidance); works for any image. ComfyUI tiles the upscale internally, so VRAM cost is minimal.
_meta.notes: 'image' is a filename in ComfyUI/input (stage the pano there first). Output lands in ComfyUI/output as PNG. 4x is fixed by the model (2048x1024 -> 8192x4096). Deterministic: same input -> same output, no seed. For equirect sources, verify the wrap seam after upscaling - the left/right edges are processed in different tiles, so run a seam check (column continuity at u=0/1) before shipping.
